claim: For the Lambda proxy integration, the integration type value is AWS_PROXY. With this integration you do not set the integration request or the integration response; API Gateway passes the incoming request from the client as the input to the backend Lambda function.

evidence.quote: For the Lambda proxy integration, the value is `AWS_PROXY`.

With this type of integration, also known as the Lambda proxy integration, you do not set the integration request or the integration response. API Gateway passes the incoming request from the client as the input to the backend Lambda function.
